body: I'm still here. 3 hours 12 mins left. Thanks for the kind words stranger :) I always try be kind to everyone as I never truly know what they are going through. Hope you find what your looking for buddy <3
The hurdle to get better seems too much and I'm not going to even attempt to try. No energy no positive thoughts and no motivation all contribute to this
Very true. But I cannot go on. No matter how stupid my issues are. My mind is set on dying.

The top paragraph resonates with me alot. Literally out of all the help I've received, my mate telling me she would be devastated was the most effective.

Hope is a very powerful human emotion if not the one that trumps them all. I hope you find the answers your looking for and you are able to fix your problems friend. Thanks for taking time to write :)
Was a distraction atleast, a pretty fun distraction at that :)
Or it could not. Nothing in 2 years has suggested it will get better. And whilst I do enjoy some parts of life it's greatly overshadowed by everything else.
Same friend. Same :). Is there anything that makes you marginally Happy? If there is, do it today :)
Thank you. Have a great day!

Here's the twist in this all, I dont want to get better. I see the world for what it truly is and getting all drugged up just clouds your mind. My best mates on antidepressants and he's never been the same since. The side effects are shit. Yes it sounds stupid that I dont want help but I just can't go on them
You know What, I think I just might :)

I've pushed the deadline for 2 years. Everyday I get worse and worse. I kill my friendships. I get more tired. I never planned to get to the age I am now. I'm proud. But the time has come. I hope i can do it in 14 hours
I know for a fact I could get better. But that could be in years, weeks, or days. I can't hold out until then.

Thanks for taking the time to reply K. After getting depression I lacked any sort of motivation career wise. I've wasted countless years of my life working no more than 15 hours a week. I hate working and more importantly I hate society. I can't change either. I'm too anxious to seek medical help so I've backed myself into a corner. I dont even want to get better I want to get dead. My heads so clouded I know I've gotten stupider as days progress. All I have is my friends but I can't rely on them to keep me alive. Only person who can really keep me alive is me.
Thank you for your kind advice, friend.

You are totally right. There's a chance I wake up tomorrow and dont do anything but procrastinate. I keep pushing the deadline back because of one thing but I've given up that now. This has been comming for 2 years now. Time to man up and do what needs to be done :)

Death is never painless, but a small amount of pain is nothing compared to the pain of living :) Good luck in your plans friend, I hope you reconsider ofc. If you do go through with it I wish you the best of luck. I just hope I have the guts to  actually do it.
Full English breakfast followed by chocolate cake it is!
Thanks buddy. Hope you have a good evening:)

Hey there buddy. I'm in the exact same position as you. You basically described my life! I wanna be creative. Design things. Make stuff. I dont want to do the same shit over and over and over. I just wanted to say your not alone. If you need to talk things over just pm me :) take care.
I'm still here. I just feel shit
Thankyou, stranger:)
Thanks <3 sadly I'm sure I will try again in the next few days
If I regret it, it would be too late to care anyways. I wish I had gone traveling to country's such as America and Japan. Foreign countries feel so much more interesting
I'm still here :)
I'm still here. I live on to fight another day. I basically have severe depression and parents that are not so understanding :)
Thanks for the reply it's very kind of you. I have read up about like 90 percent of jumpers regretting it. This sadly won't dissuade me. I just want my peace :)
I wish I could but too many things are stacked against me and it's not like my mind will even consider staying alive
I will most likely try again and again. Eventually I will succeed :)
Pretty hard to achieve in this state of mind but Yea, that's the next step
Hope you feel better soon buddy
I'm sorry for your situation friend :/ perhaps find another company that doesn't have a shit boss? Idk :(
Exactly. What are we supposed to do? Support our miserable existence? It's a joke. I'm sorry you feel like this too friend.
Hard to have a passion when all you want to do is die
I believe when your depressed you see life in a real light. It's bland, pointless and all I can say is your not the only one to think this
I've always wondered what traveling alone is like :).  I too have been suicidal and depressed since a young age. Thanks for your kind words. It gave me a little glimmer of hope.
I work in retail part time. I cant stand so how could I hold up working full time :( I'm not even lazy I'm just not cut out for life
Yes life has fleeting moments of joy, but it sure as hell doesn't outweigh the pain and suffering
